snippet.title: Octopus Energy
snippet.description:
Powering the world's transition to renewable energy

In 2016, we were a tiny British energy supplier, disrupting a broken industry. In 2025, we power homes in the UK, Germany, the USA, Japan, Spain, Italy, France and New Zealand with green energy. And more than a supplier, Octopus Energy Group is a global energy transition collective. 10 businesses working across 4 continents to tackle energy transformation at nearly every front.

We're making energy fair, clean, and simple for all using technology. Powering 8 million+ UK homes and businesses with award-winning green electricity today. And building the sustainable energy system of tomorrow.

⚡ How to get your system back online and producing
⚡ How to keep your panels working long-term — without the sales pitch

From burnt connectors to warranty fights, I show what really happens on rooftops every day.

snippet.description:

We’re documenting the many ways that people are experimenting with alternative homes and lifestyles in their own creative, and inspiring ways.

We cover a lot of topics from living off-grid to micro-apartments in the city, from homesteading to self-built tiny houses, sustainable living, and everything in between.  We also feature a wide variety of spaces with interesting and innovative designs as well as alternative building techniques and materials.

You can dive right into our playlists with hundreds of videos you might be interested in, and we’re always posting new videos so subscribe to the channel and click the bell to find out about new uploads!

Happy exploring and thanks for watching :)

snippet.title: Can't Contain Us
snippet.description:
NEW VIDEOS EVERY WEEK
Cody and I met in Texas, fell in love, and took a leap of faith. We sold our house, let go of almost everything, and chased a dream. That dream brought us to 20 acres of raw land where we’re building a shipping container tiny home from the ground up. It hasn’t been easy, but every challenge—from weather setbacks to learning as we go—has made us more determined. Our goal is to live simply, self-sufficiently, and fully off-grid. With our three dogs, eight chickens, and two ducks by our side, we’re sharing our journey of creating a cozy, intentional lifestyle through DIY projects, homesteading, and plenty of trial and error. If you love the outdoors, sustainable living, or chasing big dreams, you’re in the right place. Follow along and see what we can accomplish together.

Instagram: @cantcontainus
Facebook: @cantcontainus
TikTok: @cantcontainus

snippet.title: Undecided with Matt Ferrell
snippet.description:
As a UI/UX designer by trade, I explore how sustainable and smart technologies impact our lives. And I try to dive deeper into those topics to provide context.

Topics like electric vehicles, solar panels, and renewable energy that is meant to transition the world off of fossil fuels.  Smart home technology that can make our homes not only more convenient, but safer and more accessible.  Wearable technology that can track our health and save lives. Exploring how technology impacts our lives.

snippet.title: Jake Tran
snippet.description:
Jake Tran is an American entrepreneur and YouTuber known for documentary-style videos on money, power, and how the world works. His flagship channel, Jake Tran, has 1.8M subscribers — part of a combined audience of more than 2.1M across his channels. He’s been featured in Business Insider.

Beyond the documentaries, he founded the skincare brand Evil Goods and the creator-education program Viral Profits, and in 2025 launched a new on-camera channel, YOU CAN JUST DO THINGS, documenting his pursuit of mastery across multiple domains.. More info at the website jaketran.io.

snippet.title: The Solar Lab
snippet.description:
Welcome to The Solar Lab! We’re Cody, Robbie, and a growing team dedicated to give people confidence going solar. Through honest product reviews and clear, easy-to-understand education, we give you everything you need to make informed decisions and spend your hard-earned money wisely.

We decline all sponsorships from manufacturers, ensuring our reviews stay 100% honest and unbiased. If we recommend a product, it’s because we put it to the test - not because someone paid us to.

If you have an interest in solar, seeing the latest products or are in the market for a solution, you’re in the right place.
